title: Investigating a nostro break

steps.title: Open the USD nostro account with breaks
Select the statement debit and the ledger payment and compare them
Check amount, reference and value date
Manually match the pair with reason 'value date difference'
Raise a query to the correspondent for the unexplained debit
Write the query, set a follow-up date and send it
Refresh and check the unmatched value equals the open break

decisions: If the amount and reference agree and the value dates are one business day apart, manually match the pair with the reason 'value date difference'; if the amount differs or there is no ledger item, do not match and raise a query with the correspondent.
warnings: Never force a match where the amounts differ just to clear the ageing report; audit samples manual matches every month.
Queries go out without approval, but write-offs need approval.
openQuestions: Whether Coraline Federal Trust has started a monthly account fee that explains the USD 240 debit: Ingrid will confirm with the correspondent banking team before the next statement.
